title: 30A East Sea Sanctuary Seacrest Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Condo!* Short Walk to the Beach * Views of 12,000 Sq. Ft. Community Pool - Enjoy incredible views of one of the area's largest...
description_expanded: Overview5.0(10 reviews)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Condo!* Short Walk to the Beach * Views of 12,000 Sq. Ft. Community Pool - Enjoy incredible views of one of the area's largest resort-style pools* 3 Private Balconies-The second balcony offers a peek of the gulf and is perfect for sunset watching* 4 Bikes Included!* Walk to Restaurants and Shops* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. ** Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest so we can further assist!Welcome to Sea Sanctuary, a luxurious third-floor condo in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Occupying the entire third floor and offers approximately 1,800 square feet of living space. With three separate balconies, you'll have plenty of opportunities to relax outdoors. The first balcony offers a spacious area for dining and lounging while overlooking the pool. The second provides a small Gulf view and is a wonderful spot to enjoy a sunset, while the third features a cozy café table. Inside, the open-concept living area provides plenty of space for everyone to gather. The fully equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances and granite countertops making it easy to prepare everything from quick breakfast to family dinners. Sea Sanctuary offers two spacious King master suites, each with a private bathroom, walk-in closet, and TV. The additional bedrooms include a Queen bedroom and a bedroom with two Double beds, allowing the condo to comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests. Whether you're traveling with family, friends, or multiple families, Sea Sanctuary provides the space, amenities, and location for an unforgettable 30A beach vacation.The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom 1:King Bed with Private BathroomMaster Bedroom 2:King Bed with Private BathroomGuest Bedroom 3:Queen BedGuest Bedroom 4:2 Double BedsArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
